registryEntry.label: Create Audit Log Retention Policy (1 Year)
registryEntry.get_command: Get-UnifiedAuditLogRetentionPolicy | Where-Object Name -like 'CMMC*' | Select-Object Name,RetentionDuration | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
registryEntry.set_command: if (-not (Get-UnifiedAuditLogRetentionPolicy | Where-Object Name -eq 'CMMC-1Year-Retention')) { New-UnifiedAuditLogRetentionPolicy -Name 'CMMC-1Year-Retention' -Description 'CMMC AU retention 1 year' -RetentionDuration TwelveMonths -Priority 1 -RecordTypes AzureActiveDirectory,ExchangeAdmin,SharePoint,OneDrive } else { Get-UnifiedAuditLogRetentionPolicy | Where-Object Name -eq 'CMMC-1Year-Retention' | Select-Object Name,RetentionDuration }

metadata.commandExecuted: if (-not (Get-UnifiedAuditLogRetentionPolicy | Where-Object Name -eq 'CMMC-1Year-Retention')) { New-UnifiedAuditLogRetentionPolicy -Name 'CMMC-1Year-Retention' -Description 'CMMC AU retention 1 year' -RetentionDuration TwelveMonths -Priority 1 -RecordTypes AzureActiveDirectory,ExchangeAdmin,SharePoint,OneDrive } else { Get-UnifiedAuditLogRetentionPolicy | Where-Object Name -eq 'CMMC-1Year-Retention' | Select-Object Name,RetentionDuration }
